title: profile: the role badge and Role field show the auth library's raw user.role, so the platform admin reads as "user"
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: avatar menu → Profile as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai`: the badge under the name and the read-only *Role* field both read "user".

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the console / identity owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Filed on the maintainer's word: 「Profile 页把平台管理员的角色显示成 "user"」.

## What happens

The profile shows the auth library's raw `user.role` field (`ProfilePage` renders `user.role ?? 'member'`). The console decides admin status elsewhere (`useWorkspaceAdminStatus`, from positions and permission sets), so the page tells an administrator they are a plain "user". The value is an untranslated machine word, and the fallback `member` is a third vocabulary.

## Expected

The profile states the access the console actually resolves (e.g. *Workspace administrator*, the positions and permission sets held), translated — or drops the badge.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Read the same admin/position source the console uses for gating; render positions and permission sets by label.

## Environment

Source read on objectui `main` at `82500a7` and objectstack `main` at `033e5c53`. Live observations are from the 2026-10-07 browser QA pass: `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` (objectstack `879bd38c`), console from objectui `179f6fe9`, Chromium 141 at 1440×900, signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai`.
